test_title: PYST 12: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: FCMJ is related to HEOL in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, RQBL is related to TSDN. To which of the following is MUAG related following the same logic?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/502e5012607451288c8c23e10adfd1e61dfd7e5865973fb54fb09953c8031788.png] ​

**Logic: '2' is added to the positional value of each alphabet.**

FCMJ is related to HEOL →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05de06f8fc97303028863fa58df444ee2473072821f09c682bedcbe67b8095f5.png] 

RQBL is related to TSDN →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58e41030259ff53f9ff8e41d582bdc5c6d712ee72c40e00cc1dcf2b14e1544d4.png] 

Similarly, 'MUAG' will be related to:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e838f040573030ecf7549b3fd445e67b966aa74d8aeefff9446043090f68e34d.png] 

Here, 'MUAG' is related to **'OWCI'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
